item.title: Deer Killing Set to Start March 9 in Leakin, Druid Hill, and Herring Parks
item.description: Baltimore will bring USDA sharpshooters to city parks starting March 9 to reduce overpopulated deer. Some residents are calling for less harsh alternatives as nighttime park closures begin.

item.title: Man Dies After Being Struck by MTA Train at Shot Tower Station
item.description: Baltimore fire officials say a man died after being struck by an MTA train at Shot Tower Station Tuesday afternoon, prompting a temporary service suspension and delays.

item.title: BGE Pauses Baltimore Peninsula Transmission Line Plans in Port Covington
item.description: BGE says it will temporarily pause work on transmission line projects tied to Baltimore Peninsula after Senate President Bill Ferguson called for increased oversight, cost scrutiny, and more community engagement.

item.title: Maryland Judiciary Warns of Fake “Court Summons” Text Scam in Baltimore
